```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Identify full grid separator rows and columns.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    sep_color = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else None
    # Keep only columns that are uniformly the separator color.
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]

    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Copy the non-background pattern from the upper-left panel into every panel.
    r0, r1 = row_bounds[0] + 1, row_bounds[1]
    c0, c1 = col_bounds[0] + 1, col_bounds[1]
    panel = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    background = max(set(v for row in panel for v in row),
                     key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in panel))

    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        a, b = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            x, y = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            for dr in range(min(b - a, len(panel))):
                for dc in range(min(y - x, len(panel[0]))):
                    value = panel[dr][dc]
                    if value != background:
                        out[a + dr][x + dc] = value
    return out
```
